hero.subtitle: Design branching storylines, complex variable state machines, and interactive visual novels using a high-performance local-first graph engine.

steps.title: Visual Node
steps.description: Drag-and-drop Dialogue, Choice, Condition, Action, and Input nodes onto an infinite canvas to compose branching narratives without writing a line of code.
bullets: Snap-to-grid graph canvas powered by React Flow
Type-specific inspector panels for every node
Structural integrity scanner catches dangling links live

steps.title: Real-Time

bullets: JIT evaluation of variable math and branching guards
Inventory HUD reflects state changes as they happen

capabilities.title: Built for Serious Interactive Fiction
capabilities.subtitle: Every layer of the engine — from storage to interpretation — is engineered for reliability at production scale.

items.title: Local-First & IndexedDB
items.description: Instant state syncing with Dexie.js, zero server costs, and total data privacy — every project lives entirely on-device.

items.title: JIT Expression Evaluator
items.description: Real-time evaluation of branching logic, variable math, and item pouch constraints as the player advances the story.

items.title: Interpreter Architecture
items.description: Complete decoupling of the JSON schema specification from the rendering viewport, so runtime, editor, and exporters share one source of truth.

items.title: Advanced Flow Control
items.description: Native support for Subgraphs, Fork/Merge parallel traversal, and character-creation Input nodes for deep, replayable narratives.

nodeVisualizer.title: Every Node Type, Inspected
nodeVisualizer.subtitle: Toggle between node types to preview their properties and runtime execution behavior.

nodeTypes.label: Dialogue
nodeTypes.behavior: Renders a chat bubble bound to the speaker portrait, then halts traversal until the player advances.

nodeTypes.label: Choice
nodeTypes.behavior: Filters out any choice whose condition fails, then routes the player to the selected targetNodeId.

nodeTypes.label: Condition
nodeTypes.behavior: evaluateCondition() coerces types and routes to the true or false branch with zero player input.

nodeTypes.label: Action
nodeTypes.behavior: Mutates variables or inventory in-place, then auto-advances — or reroutes to failureNodeId if a constraint fails.

nodeTypes.label: Input
nodeTypes.behavior: Pauses the interpreter and waits for submitPlayerInput() before flattening values into global variables.
